rationale: Evidence from iteration 4 (score 313.7, the best raced so far, kp 2.6, kd 0.45, ki 0.1, base_speed 1.2, sensors at x = -0.07 to 0.07): line_loss_events fell to 0.15 on the oval and 0.0 on the s-bend and slalom, so the widened span is working. Steering oscillation is still above the 0.2 level on the oval (0.286) and just above it on the s-bend (0.213). The slalom is well under (0.102). Off-track endings remain the main loss: 13 of 20 oval finishes, 0 finishes on the s-bend and slalom, and s-bend max_error of 0.0617, just past the 0.06 m limit. The evaluator's rule for this case is to raise kd toward 0.6 while holding kp at 2.6, so that is the single change I make. Changes: kd 0.45 to 0.60. Everything else is held fixed: kp 2.6, ki 0.1, base_speed 1.2, the ±0.07 m five-sensor span, sensor_size 0.016, the weights, and the body, wheel and mass values. Expected: oscillation on the oval and s-bend falls below 0.2 with the extra damping, which should cut the off-track wandering and raise oval finishes and s-bend progress. Risk: more kd amplifies sensor noise, which could raise oscillation on the slalom, and the s-bend max_error may stay near 0.06. Hypotheses to check next: (a) steering_oscillation drops below 0.2 on the oval and s-bend; (b) max_error on the s-bend stays under 0.06; (c) if the run is clean, base_speed 1.3 is the next step to test completion_time under 3 s. If oscillation is still high at kd 0.6, the next test is a sensor y-position change or sensor_size 0.012 for the off-track endings.
